Hi Arjun,

Thanks for reaching out, and we understand how important stable ping is for gaming.

First, some good news: there is no outage or network issue currently reported in your area (Hinjewadi), so your connection is up and running as expected.

Latency (ping) to international servers like Singapore depends heavily on routing conditions beyond our local network, which is why it can fluctuate week to week even when your line itself is healthy. While we can't promise an exact timeline for routing improvements, here are a few quick checks you can do on your side to rule out local causes:

1. Restart your router — switch it off for 30 seconds, then power it back on.
2. Test with a wired (Ethernet) connection rather than Wi-Fi — Wi-Fi adds latency, and evening speeds can drop when many devices are connected.
3. If you're on Wi-Fi, move closer to the router and run a test at fast.com to confirm your speeds look normal.

If your wired speed and ping to Indian servers look fine but Singapore ping stays high, it's very likely upstream international routing, which tends to settle as routes re-converge.

If the problem persists, just reply to this email with your test results (time of day, server, and ping readings) and we'll take it further.

Warm regards,
Acme Fibre Support
